official_definition: You can put as many cores from your Spirits/Contract Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Contract Awaken] or [Contract Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Contract Awaken]", "give [Contract Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
